errors.text_span: Секторът „81 - 100 услуги“ е представен в зелено и има дял от 28,3%.
errors.evidence: The green slice, which represents "81 - 100 услуги", is one of the smallest and does not have a percentage label. The value of 28.3% corresponds to the purple slice, labeled "Над 100 услуги".

errors.text_span: Във всеки сектор е посочен неговият процентен дял
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. Not every sector has a percentage label inside it. The green sector ("81 - 100 услуги") and the light blue sector ("Не се предоставят") do not have percentage labels.

errors.text_span: а сектора се вижда да са подредени по низходящ ред на размера
errors.evidence: The slices of the pie chart are not arranged in descending order of size. For example, the largest slice (32.6%) is adjacent to a smaller slice (15.2%), not the second largest (28.3%).
